content: {"reasoning":"CO-197 requires addressing the missing authorization; retroactive authorization and peer-to-peer review are unavailable, and no claim-data error supports correction. Although a necessity appeal was previously attempted, the case does not establish that appeal rights are exhausted, and appeals are the only action with documented payment success among similar claims (2/12). A further formal necessity appeal using the supporting clinical documentation is preferable to resubmission or transferring a contractual denial to the patient.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
